name: Exam-Prompt — AI Exam Preparation System
description: Universal skill hub for AI-powered exam preparation. 30+ skills, any university worldwide. Pre-configured for SPPU, adaptable globally.

answer-writer.description: Generates A+ exam answers for any university — all question types, all mark levels

notes-generator.description: Creates exam-ready notes in 12+ formats (Cornell, Outline, Flowchart, Q&A, etc.)

pyq-analyzer.description: Analyzes previous year question papers with 13+ statistical methods

imp-topics.description: Generates high-probability exam topics with time-based preparation plans

exam-paper-generator.description: Generates full question papers for 11+ university patterns

flashcard-generator.description: Converts study material to Anki/Quizlet/CSV flashcards with SRS metadata

study-planner.description: Generates personalized day-by-day study schedules with spaced repetition

pre-prompt: echo 'Read AGENTS_LEARNING.md for cross-session context before starting work.'
